title: Wall Mount Towel Ring 6-Inch Diameter Solid Brass, Foxtrot Collection | Glokzin Teal | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom towel storage with a wall mount towel ring crafted from solid brass and sized at a 6-inch diameter for daily hand towels in Glokzin Teal, which delivers rich, jewel-toned sophistication, adding artistic depth and a designer touch to modern bathrooms.

  • Glokzin Teal transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Clean installation: Concealed screw mounting helps maintain a streamlined appearance.
  • Hardware included: Ships with the towel ring and all installation hardware.
  • Built for everyday use: Solid brass construction.

  • Collection: Foxtrot

  • Overall size (L x W x H): 6 x 6 x 6 inches
